english.title: Assault or wilfully obstruct British sea-fishery officer while exercising Sea Fisheries Act 1968 powers

english.legislation: Contrary to section 10(2)(c) and (4) of the Sea Fisheries Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
assaulted/wilfully obstructed
a British sea-fishery officer
while exercising/in the exercise of any of his/her powers
conferred on him/her under section 8 or section 9 of the Sea Fisheries Act 1968

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) MoPI notes: may be Group 3 if there is no assault/violence.
(ii) Section 14 of the Sea Fisheries Act 1968 provides that proceedings for an offence under section 10 may be taken, and the offence may for all incidental purposes be treated as having been committed, in any place in the United Kingdom.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine.
Indictment: A fine.

None
